hold_reason: Refund discrepancy: W2's handoff says order 150 (customer acme) was refunded 12682 cents, but list_refunds shows only order 151 (15870) and order 155 (4209). The refund for order 150 is not in the ledger. Paying acme now could overpay it, and payouts cannot be recalled. Needs confirmation from Alpha Co whether the order 150 refund was applied before any payouts are recorded.

reply.thought: Before paying anyone, I want to check the actual order and refund data rather than rely only on the handoff message. I'll start by listing the orders.
